title: Zesty Crisp Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian dish with a malty and crisp twist, featuring lamb, vanilla extract, and a blend of spices, all cooked to perfection in a kazan cauldron.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the kazan cauldron over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the cauldron and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the cauldron and cook until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the cauldron and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb back to the cauldron, along with the chicken broth and vanilla extract.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Remove the cauldron from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Strain the tagine through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan, discarding the solids.
Skim off any excess fat that rises to the surface.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
